hints.title: Static Calendar Year Series
hints.text: Sales spans cover years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Construct or join against these three calendar years.

hints.title: Date Overlap Computation
hints.text: The active sales duration in year Y is datediff(least(period_end, concat(Y, "-12-31")), greatest(period_start, concat(Y, "-01-01"))) + 1.

hints.title: Revenue Aggregation by Year
hints.text: Multiply overlapping days by average_daily_revenue where period_start <= concat(Y, "-12-31") and period_end >= concat(Y, "-01-01").

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH RECURSIVE Years AS (
    SELECT 2018 AS report_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT report_year + 1 FROM Years WHERE report_year < 2020
)
SELECT p.product_id,
       p.product_name,
       CAST(y.report_year AS CHAR) AS report_year,
       (DATEDIFF(
           LEAST(s.period_end, DATE(CONCAT(y.report_year, '-12-31'))),
           GREATEST(s.period_start, DATE(CONCAT(y.report_year, '-01-01')))
       ) + 1) * s.average_daily_revenue AS total_amount
FROM Sales s
JOIN Product p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Years y ON s.period_start <= DATE(CONCAT(y.report_year, '-12-31'))
            AND s.period_end >= DATE(CONCAT(y.report_year, '-01-01'))
ORDER BY p.product_id, report_year;
```

complexity.notes: Joining sales intervals with a fixed 3-year recursive sequence executes in linear time proportional to S.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Attempting to expand day-by-day generates millions of intermediate rows.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Interval clipping with LEAST and GREATEST computes overlap days in a single mathematical expression.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Date boundary clipping using LEAST and GREATEST functions joined against distinct years.

solutions.code:
WITH RECURSIVE Years AS (
    SELECT 2018 AS report_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT report_year + 1 FROM Years WHERE report_year < 2020
)
SELECT p.product_id,
       p.product_name,
       CAST(y.report_year AS TEXT) AS report_year,
       ((LEAST(s.period_end, TO_DATE(CONCAT(y.report_year, '-12-31'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) -
         GREATEST(s.period_start, TO_DATE(CONCAT(y.report_year, '-01-01'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) + 1) * s.average_daily_revenue AS total_amount
FROM Sales s
JOIN Product p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Years y ON s.period_start <= TO_DATE(CONCAT(y.report_year, '-12-31'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
            AND s.period_end >= TO_DATE(CONCAT(y.report_year, '-01-01'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
ORDER BY p.product_id, report_year;
